title: The Danger of Being Easily Offended
summaryZh: 魔鬼常將冒犯與苦毒偽裝成屬靈的分辨力，藉此蒙蔽我們的理智。
lines: I don't want the poison of offense to cloud my vision, my seeing.
我不希望冒犯的毒根蒙蔽我的異象、我的眼光。
I don't want it to affect my thinking, my reasoning, because it does.
我不希望它影響我的思考和理智，因為它確實會。
The target is to get offense, to get bitterness, envy, any of these things,
它的目標是要讓你產生冒犯、苦毒、嫉妒或任何這類東西，
to get it somewhere influencing the reasoning,
讓它在某處影響你的理智，
so that I'm not able to demonstrate the heart of God on planet earth in the measure He desires.
以至於我無法按照神所渴望的程度，在地球上彰顯祂的心意。
Let's go to James chapter three.
我們來看《雅各書》第三章。
What we're going to see here is we recognize that the devil doesn't come to us in a red rubber suit with horns and a pitchfork.
我們在這裡將會看到，我們會認清魔鬼不會穿著紅色橡膠裝、頭上長角、拿著乾草叉來到我們面前。
He doesn't make himself known as the devil.
他不會表明自己就是魔鬼。
He makes himself known as something we would value.
他會把自己偽裝成我們所看重的東西。
He actually has to parade his thoughts as virtuous thoughts for us to embrace them.
實際上，他必須把他的思想標榜為美善的思想，好讓我們去接受。
That was a good point, Bill, that was a really good point.
講得好，比爾，這點講得真好。
He has to actually parade what the Bible calls him, the angel of light.
實際上他必須這樣標榜自己——就像聖經稱他為「光明的天使」。
So he has to parade himself in a way where we think or feel that we are discerning or moving in some sort of a virtue.
所以他必須以一種方式來標榜自己，讓我們認為或感覺自己很有分辨力，或者正行在某種美德中。
The problem is that way of life, that way of thinking does not carry peace with it.
問題是，那種生活方式、那種思維模式並沒有帶來平安。
It does not bear the fruit of peace or righteousness.
它結不出平安或公義的果子。
So let's go into this passage out of James chapter 3.
所以讓我們來看這段出自《雅各書》第三章的經文。
'Who is wise and understanding among you?
「你們中間誰是有智慧有見識的呢？
Let him show by good conduct that his works are done in the meekness of wisdom.'
他就當在智慧的溫柔上顯出他的善行來。」
I love that phrase, 'meekness of wisdom,' my goodness.
我好喜歡「智慧的溫柔」這個詞，天哪。
Don't pursue wisdom without meekness, or don't think you have it unless there's meekness.
不要追求沒有溫柔的智慧，除非有溫柔，否則別以為你擁有智慧。
Meekness isn't weakness; meekness is yielded strength.
溫柔不是軟弱；溫柔是降服的力量。
The biblical illustration of meekness is the wild horse that becomes trained.
聖經中關於溫柔的比喻，就像一匹被馴服的野馬。
It's still as strong to jump the biggest fence,
牠依然強壯到能跳過最高的柵欄，
it just only does it at the commander's word.
只是牠只在主人的口令下才會這麼做。
'If you have bitter envy, self-seeking in your hearts, do not boast and lie against the truth.'
「你們心裡若懷著苦毒的嫉妒和分爭，就不可自誇，也不可說謊話抵擋真道。」
'This wisdom does not descend from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.'
「這樣的智慧不是從上頭來的，乃是屬地的，屬情慾的，屬鬼魔的。」
'For where envy and self-seeking exist, confusion and every evil thing are there.'
「在何處有嫉妒、分爭，就在何處有擾亂和各樣的壞事。」
'But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, willing to yield,'—interesting—
「惟獨從上頭來的智慧，先是清潔，後是和平，溫良柔順，」——很有意思——
'full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality and without hypocrisy.'
「滿有憐憫，多結善果，沒有偏見，沒有假冒。」
'Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.'
「並且使人和平的，是用和平所栽種的義果。」
Go back to verse 14 and 15, and then I want to talk to you for a bit.
回到第14和15節，然後我想跟你們談一下。
'If you have bitter envy, self-seeking in your heart, do not boast and lie against the truth.'
「你們心裡若懷著苦毒的嫉妒和分爭，就不可自誇，也不可說謊話抵擋真道。」
'This wisdom does not descend from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.'
「這樣的智慧不是從上頭來的，乃是屬地的，屬情慾的，屬鬼魔的。」
Bitterness, offense, jealousy, envy—all of these things carry with it the appearance of wisdom.
苦毒、冒犯、忌妒、嫉妒——所有這些東西都帶著智慧的外表。
That's why a Christian would embrace it;
這就是為什麼基督徒會接受它；
它讓我們覺得自己很有分辨力。
